name: Alcaudete de la Jara (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, red and green with a white triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned arms of Alcaudete de la Jara.
history: Municipal flag of Alcaudete de la Jara; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
Alcaudete de la Jara arms — tower, bird and deer within a yellow border
border and crown of the arms
